items.title: SNPS Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on EDA and Ansys Strength
items.summary: Synopsys beats Q3 estimates as EDA and Ansys fuel strong growth, while higher margins and an upgraded fiscal 2026 outlook add momentum.

items.title: CRWD Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on ARR and Falcon Flex Strength
items.summary: CrowdStrike beats Q2 estimates as record net new ARR, Falcon Flex adoption and AI-security demand drive growth and a higher fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: NVIDIA Q2 Earnings Beat on Blackwell Ultra & Data Center Strength
items.summary: NVDA's Q2 results top expectations as Blackwell Ultra fuels record Data Center growth, while Vera Rubin is set to gain prominence in Q3.

items.title: Lam Research Invests $1.5 Billion in Oregon to Expand Chip R&D
items.summary: Tim Archer, CEO of Lam Research, said that his company is investing over a billion dollars to stay ahead of AI buildout demand and the accelerating pace of AI innovation. Archer said that new AI models are demanding more computational power, bandwidth and storage and Lam Research is focused on semiconductor chip innovation to meet those needs.

items.title: AMAT's AGS Business Gains Momentum: How Long Will it Sustain?
items.summary: Applied Materials' AGS business achieves record revenues and expanding margins, with growth fueled by subscription services, parts demand and rising fab utilization.

items.title: Lam Research vs. Microchip: Which Chip Stock Is the Better Buy?
items.summary: LRCX looks like the better chip-stock buy, supported by AI-driven growth, strong earnings momentum, recurring services and a robust balance sheet.

items.title: Semtech's Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: SMTC's Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings and revenues beat estimates as data center demand, LoRa growth and stronger margins fuel year-over-year gains.

items.title: These 8 chip stocks now offer enhanced buying opportunities, BofA says
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America told clients in a note on Tuesday that the risk/reward in semiconductors is positive despite near-term pressure, with the bank flagging eight names as enhanced buying opportunities.
